No gene reached q<0.05; top by effect FLG set 21.1% vs rest 2.4%, OR=10.93 (95% CI 1.84-65.12), Fisher p=0.0102, q=0.223; BAP1 set 0% vs rest 15.5%, OR=0.14 (95% CI 0.01-2.39), p=0.119, q=0.836.
No continuous or gain/loss feature reached q<0.05; top continuous chr2p Cliff's delta=0.386, q=1.0; top gain/loss locus::VHL loss set 94.7% vs rest 79.8%, OR=4.57 (95% CI 0.57-36.66), q=1.0.

key_evidence.statistical_interpretation: No significant biological enrichment in any modality after FDR correction. RNA shows only nominal trends, WXS has a nominal FLG enrichment but not significant after correction, and CNV shows no significant differences. The set lacks strong molecular support.
key_evidence.medical_interpretation: There is no clear molecular signature distinguishing this set from the rest; any observed differences are not statistically robust.
limitations: No significant findings after multiple-testing correction.
Small set size (n=19) and multiple testing reduce power.
CNV and WXS trends have wide confidence intervals.

observations.finding: Global tests show significant associations for tissue_source_site (Cramer's V=0.290, q=0.004), ct_manufacturer (V=0.372, q=0.004), and ct_scanner_model (V=0.213, q=0.035).

Multiple set-level technical fields reached q<0.05: tissue_source_site B8 (set 47.4% vs rest 11.9%, OR=6.66, q=0.011), BP (set 15.8% vs rest 50%, OR=0.19, q=0.050), CZ (set 26.3% vs rest 4.8%, OR=7.14, q=0.050); ct_phase NEPH (set 31.6% vs rest 2.4%, OR=18.92, q=0.005); ct_manufacturer GE (set 15.8% vs rest 79.8%, OR=0.05, q=0.000), SIEMENS (set 73.7% vs rest 19.0%, OR=11.9, q=0.000); ct_scanner_model Definition (set 15.8% vs rest 0%, q=0.036), LightSpeed16 (set 5.3% vs rest 35.7%, OR=0.10, q=0.050); ct_reconstruction_kernel STANDARD (set 15.8% vs rest 71.4%, OR=0.075, q=0.000); ct_slice_thickness (Cliff's delta=0.398, q=0.021).
ct_slice_thickness had significant Cliff's delta=0.398, q=0.021; ct_z_spacing had Cliff's delta=0.301, q=0.100 (not significant).

key_evidence.statistical_interpretation: This set shows multiple significant technical associations, including strong enrichment of Siemens manufacturer, B8 site, NEPH phase, and specific scanner models, as well as a significant difference in slice thickness. These indicate substantial technical confounding.
key_evidence.medical_interpretation: The set's identity is strongly associated with technical factors, suggesting that biological interpretations may be confounded by acquisition parameters and site-specific effects.
limitations: Multiple technical associations are significant.
Small set size limits power to detect other associations.
Cramer's V values are moderate but below the warning threshold of 0.5.

observations.finding: Per-set median silhouettes: CT 0.011, WSI 0.004, RNA -0.016, genomic -0.0005; CT positive, others near zero or negative.
Median support count 2.0; 2/19 patients have support_count 0, 4 have 1, 11 have 2, 2 have 3; no patient has all 4 modalities positive.
Fused binary probe: child sizes 8/11, normalized cut 1.008, median silhouette 0.0007, resampling median ARI 1.0, consensus separation 0.812, PAC 0.263, degenerate fraction 0.0.
Pairwise fused silhouettes with other sets range 0.0007-0.0009; strongest modality-specific boundary is WSI with C0006 (pair median silhouette 0.044) and WSI with C0005 (0.043).

key_evidence.statistical_interpretation: The set shows moderate internal structure with high resampling ARI and consensus separation, but modality support is uneven (CT positive, others weak). Boundaries to other sets are weak in fused space but stronger in WSI.
key_evidence.medical_interpretation: The set shows some internal consistency, particularly in CT, but the lack of support from other modalities suggests it may not be a robust multi-modal cluster.
limitations: Resampling was performed on existing SNF affinity subgraph; modality affinities not re-estimated.
Negative PCoA eigenvalues discarded; PERMDISP approximate.
Structural metrics describe current partition, not independent validation.

observations.finding: Adjusted Rand Index 0.033, homogeneity 0.140, completeness 0.084 for stage across the 7 sets.
Adjusted Rand Index 0.007, homogeneity 0.072, completeness 0.039 for grade across the 7 sets.

key_evidence.statistical_interpretation: Both stage and grade show very low overlap with the partition, as indicated by ARI values near zero and low homogeneity and completeness. This suggests the partition is not a simple echo of these known labels.
key_evidence.medical_interpretation: The partition does not appear to be driven by stage or grade, indicating that the clustering is not merely recapitulating these clinical labels. However, this does not establish molecular novelty.
limitations: Only TCGA stage and grade labels are assessable.
Published molecular ccRCC subtype taxonomies were not evaluated.
Low overlap does not by itself establish molecular novelty.
